Subject-level listing

Source: R/builders-table.R
tbl_listing.Rd

Selects, renames and sorts columns, one row per record. Configured columns missing from the data are skipped and recorded in meta.

Usage

tbl_listing(
  df,
  cols,
  sort_by = c("USUBJID", "AVISITN", "PARAMCD", "ASTDT", "AESTDTC")
)

Arguments

df

Data frame.

cols

Named character vector: data column = display header. See listing_cols_ae and listing_cols_lab for defaults.

sort_by

Data columns to sort by (those present are used).

Value

A tlf_table.

See also

Other table builders: tbl_ae(), tbl_ae_severity(), tbl_demographics(), tbl_disposition(), tbl_eff(), tbl_shift(), tbl_tte()

Examples

tbl_listing(ex_adae, listing_cols_ae)
